featured_reviews.name: Penyiar
featured_reviews.review_text: We ordered some medicine online from Wellness Forever, expecting it to arrive 1 hour at the latest, but ours arrived 3 hours later! In that first hour of waiting, the courier called twice in Hindi/Marati, so I just said "across the road from Priyadarshini Park", since I had filled out the complete address information on the online form. In the 2nd hour, customer service officer called an asked what the problem is, so I just said that 90 minutes have passed and we still haven't received our medicine, so he said he would be in touch with the delivery guy. In the 3rd hour of waiting, another customer service officer called and asked me to reconfirm our address, so I did. Exactly 1 minute before 3 hours passed since we ordered, our medicine finally came. But we noticed on the paper form that our address was written down as Andheri, which is very far from our PDP location. No wonder the delivery guy was confused; but how did this happen? Since the Wellness Forever at Nepean Sea Road closed, this branch at Pedder Road has been struggling to keep up with the needs of those who live around Priyadarshini Park. For those ready to use the Wellness Forever delivery service: 1) if the delivery guy calls, make sure he has the right address for your delivery no matter how silly your inquiry sounds, 2) make sure you speak Hindia/Marati, and 3) best to give a 3-hour delivery period.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Penyiar,
We sincerely apologize that you did not have a desirable experience. 
Wellness Forever always prioritizes service and quality for its customers.
To help us resolve your query please connect with us on WhatsApp @ 9920109090

owner_posts.post_text:
What if one idea could change the future of medicine? In 1796, Samuel Hahnemann introduced homeopathy—built on precision, personalization, and safety. Today, this legacy continues through modern care offered at trusted clinics across India. You can consult experienced doctors in person or begin your journey online, with a thoughtful approach to managing chronic and recurring health concerns worldwide.
1. A Medical Revolution - Hahnemann replaced harsh treatments with a more refined, patient-focused approach.
2. Personalized Healing Approach - Every treatment is tailored, core to modern homeopathic treatment systems.
3. From 1796 to Digital Care - Now accessible globally through online homeopathic clinic consultations.

A 58-year-old woman suffering from Trigeminal Neuralgia for over three years struggled with severe, electric shock-like facial pain—even after undergoing two surgeries. With recurring episodes affecting her daily life, she explored a personalized homeopathic treatment approach at Life Force. Over a carefully monitored 22-month journey, her condition showed gradual and meaningful improvement, highlighting a structured, individualized, and integrative approach to managing chronic nerve pain conditions.

✔️ Repeated Relapses Despite Surgery - The patient had undergone two surgical procedures, yet the facial pain returned—more intense and frequent than before.
✔️ Gradual Reduction in Pain Episodes - From experiencing 7–9 severe attacks daily, her condition improved significantly over time, with reduced frequency, duration, and intensity of episodes.
✔️ Sustained Functional Improvement - By the later phase of treatment, she achieved around 70% improvement and was able to carry out daily activities comfortably without regular dependence on painkillers.
